messages:
Alice M: :rotating_light: seeing a sudden p99 jump for inference path since ~11:02 UTC, streaming tails spiking and a couple of customers reporting stalls. p95 up ~450ms -> 900ms, p99 up to 2.4s. impact: streaming sessions time out.
SRE Oncall: On it. Can you paste the scope? which routes/models/regions?
Alice M: Mostly /v1/chat and /v1/stream in us-east-1. Affected models: rwd-llama-13b and rwd-flare-7b in the hosted pool.
Alice M: Quick metrics: total requests steady, error rate low, but a big increase in backend latency on the auth/config fetch stage before the gateway forward.
IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2026-374567 - inference tail latency spike; paging SRE.
SRE Oncall: I see correlated auth token DB p99 and configstore fetch p99 at ~11:01. Older trace shows control-plane calls blocking request threads.
Raj P: tagging infra - I can check DB connection saturation and recent deploys to configstore.
Max G: looking at gateway logs, many 200s from model servers but long wait in preflight: "auth: token-validate" step. Example trace: 
```
preflight -> auth/validate -> configstore/get -> reserve-slot -> forward
latency: preflight 1.8s, auth/validate 1.5s, configstore/get 0.2s
```
SRE Oncall: That suggests auth path is the culprit (tokenstore or auth service). Any throttles showing?
Raj P: Tokenstore shows CPU at 78% and connection queue growing. There was increased retry volume from a CD deploy earlier.
Elaine (PM): Are customers being dropped or just delayed? Do we have any streaming session disconnects?
Alice M: A couple of enterprise customers reported partial transcript gaps (stream stalls) and two sessions timed out after 10s. No broad failures yet.
SRE Oncall: Initial mitigation idea: 1) Enable short-circuit bypass for token validation for low-risk internal tokens (can flip feature flag) 2) Increase tokenstore read replicas / scale horizontally 3) Route traffic to dedicated reserved pool for high-tier customers as fallback.
Max G: We can flip feature flag quickly for a canary subset (10% traffic) then widen if stable. Flag key: token-validate.short_circuit.
Raj P: Scaling read replicas will take 3-4min for spawn + warmup. I'll queue it now.
SRE Oncall: Doing the flag canary now. Executing: 
```
ops tool flags set token-validate.short_circuit=true --scope=10% --by=oncall
```
OpsBot: Flag change accepted: token-validate.short_circuit=true scope=10% user=SRE Oncall
SRE Oncall: Monitoring p99 on auth path...
(Max G reacts with :eyes:)
SRE Oncall: After canary (10%) p99 for auth path down ~300ms for those requests, overall p99 still high but trending.
Raj P: Replica scale starting: added 2 read replicas for tokenstore cluster token-db-prod-1.
IncidentBot: Replica scale event: token-db-prod-1 +2 replicas requested by Raj P.
Alice M: p95 improving in 2 min windows to ~350ms, p99 holding ~1.1-1.6s. Streaming stalls reduced but still present for long-tail sessions.
SRE Oncall: Next step: apply an emergency routing policy to prefer reserved/dedicated model pool for sessions that require streaming low-latency. This will push some traffic to dedicated capacity. Any objections?
Elaine (PM): Go ahead, prioritize customer UX. Note to sales: we'll need to note affected customers and whether we used dedicated fallback.
Max G: Routing policy change ready. Command: 
```
routing apply --matcher="streaming=true AND region=us-east-1" --policy=prefer:dedicated-reserved --dry-run=false
```
OpsBot: Routing policy applied by Max G.
SRE Oncall: After routing change p95 ~220ms, p99 ~480ms for streamed sessions. Non-streamed still noisy.
Raj P: Tokenstore CPU normalized after replicas warmed; connection queue cleared. Scaling helped.
Alice M: Mirroring customer reports: some clients still saw stalls where their session began before routing flip (KV cache miss + auth retry propagation).
SRE Oncall: Implemented temporary rate smoothing on gateway to reduce retry storm: 
```
gateway --set retry_backoff=200ms --max_concurrent_prefight=800
```
Max G: Also enabled KV prefix caching warmup for sessions migrated to dedicated pool to avoid cold starts.
Alice M: Good improvements. We should now capture timeline and handoff for oncall.
SRE Oncall: Handoff summary for next oncall in case it regresses: 
- Root cause: auth/tokenstore became a bottleneck under increased retry load after a configservice deploy; high preflight latency cascaded into streaming tail stalls.
- Mitigations applied: feature flag short-circuit (10% -> widened to 100% after replica scale), token-db +2 read replicas, routing fallback to dedicated-reserved pool for streaming in us-east-1, gateway retry smoothing, KV cache warmup.
- Impact: p95 improved from ~900ms -> 220ms, p99 improved from ~2.4s -> ~480ms for streaming after actions, 2 customer sessions timed out early but no sustained data loss.
- Next steps: permanent autoscaling rules for tokenstore, add health-based circuit breaker in gateway to fail fast to dedicated pool, add dashboards for preflight/auth latency and feature-flag rollouts.
SRE Oncall: Handing off to oncall team B @ 11:40 UTC. Please monitor auth p99, streaming p99, and any customer escalation Slack threads.
Elaine (PM): I'll coordinate post-incident notes and customer comms. Assigning follow-ups: Raj->tokenstore autoscale, Max->routing playbook, Alice->customer list and transcript artifacts.
IncidentBot: Incident resolved-> status: mitigated, severity: P2, duration: 00:38:39.
Alice M: Thanks all. If anyone sees regression, ping SRE Oncall and mark prefix "regress" in the thread. :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: Leaving a short checklist in ops-playbook: 
- verify tokenstore autoscaling alerts
- add canary window for token-validate.short_circuit flag
- ensure routing failover tests in staging
- postmortem steps -> Jake to own next doc sprint
Elaine (PM): I'll schedule a short customer sync for impacted tenants.
Max G: Logging the commands used and times in the incident timeline doc.
Alice M: Closing thread for now, moving to postmortem channel.
